name: Novotel Solo
short_description: A 142-room hotel on Jalan Slamet Riyadi in the heart of Solo, with two large outdoor pools, a night bar, and an InBalance Fitness and Spa.
ai_summary: Novotel Solo sits on Jalan Slamet Riyadi, Solo's main commercial avenue, putting the 142-room hotel within easy reach of the city's dining and shopping. Two large outdoor pools, a night bar, traditional massage services, and the InBalance Fitness and Spa round out the amenities. Guests consistently praise the spacious, contemporary rooms, well-maintained facilities, and friendly staff, along with strong food options, though a subset of reviews note maintenance and service inconsistencies.

faqs.question: Is Novotel Solo centrally located?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's on Jalan Slamet Riyadi, Solo's main commercial avenue, putting the hotel within easy reach of the city's dining and shopping without needing to travel to an outlying district.

faqs.question: Does Novotel Solo have a pool?
faqs.answer: Yes -- two large outdoor pools are part of the amenity set, alongside a night bar and the InBalance Fitness and Spa offering traditional massage services.
